From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Mutual Action Plan & Renewal: Blue Harbor — MAP kickoff and 90-day trajectory

Hi Elena & Raj,

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. Per our commitment, I’m starting this thread to formalize a mutual action plan (MAP) that will cover the next 90 days: evaluation criteria, success metrics, roles, and the procurement timeline so we can land the renewal and the planned expansion.

Quick context: Blue Harbor’s usage has increased ~32% QoQ and your product team flagged latency-sensitive routes that would benefit from a Dedicated pool plus Optimize recommendations. We want to make sure the MAP balances your technical validation needs with procurement and budget cycles.

Proposed immediate items:
- Week 0: MAP kickoff call (align stakeholders & dates)
- Weeks 1–3: Evaluation plan (test scenarios, SLOs, data/traffic samples)
- Weeks 4–6: Performance & cost validation (benchmarks on our Dedicated pool + quantized model profiles)
- Weeks 7–9: Procurement & contract redlines
- Week 10: Go/no-go and handoff to ops for rollout

I’ve attached a draft MAP and a usage snapshot to get us started. Marissa will own the tactical runbook and weekly checkpoints. Stephanie will run the technical evals and ben will own commercial coordination.

Can you confirm attendees from your side (procurement, legal, platform), and which evaluation windows (dev vs. staging traffic) you want us to use? Also please tell us any immovable procurement dates.

If this looks good, I’ll schedule the kickoff for Thursday or Friday this week — I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Accounts, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Vivek — thanks, this is helpful.

Confirming I’ll be the executive sponsor. I’m adding Raj (Head of Platform) and Tara (Procurement) to the thread — Raj will own technical sign-off and Tara will lead procurement timelines. For attendees from our legal team, I’ll loop them in once we get to the contract stage (we typically do redlines in week 7–8).

A couple of asks on our side:
- Can you include an acceptance criteria table in the MAP (minimum throughput, p50/p95 latency targets per route, accuracy drift tolerance)?
- We’ll need a clean usage extract for the last 90 days that maps to the top 10 call routes — that’ll help prioritize the evaluation.
- Procurement has a hard deadline: budget sign-off by 2027-06-25 (end of Q2). If we can’t commit to pricing and a draft order by then, procurement will push to the next cycle.

We’re available for a 60-minute kickoff on Friday 2027-05-14 at 11:00 PT or Monday 2027-05-17 at 09:00 PT — either works.

Thanks,
Elena

- Commercial path: Ben will prepare a preliminary order form with pricing options (hosted vs. dedicated + Optimize add-on) so procurement can review by 2027-06-15 to hit your 06-25 sign-off.

Proposed kickoff: Friday 2027-05-14 at 11:00 PT (per Elena) — I’ll send an invite for a 60-minute slot covering scope, roles, success criteria, and timeline.
